method.aggregation: Median and observed range of per-trial metrics; no pooled quantiles.
method.latency: Percentiles include successful complete byte-verified operations only; failure rates are separate.
method.comparability: Different environment, effective workload, or execution source hashes form separate groups. Missing context is disclosed.
method.timing: Recovery clocks are sampled bounds with the recorded definitions; missing route convergence remains unmeasured.
method.resources: Gateway resource values are post-phase snapshots, not peaks; CPU seconds are cumulative process lifetime, not phase utilization.
limitations: No confidence intervals or statistical significance are inferred from observed ranges.
Fault-phase gateway overload intentionally changes concurrency and rate; do not attribute that comparison solely to a network change.
A VM/namespace lab does not establish physical-network or production performance.
